functions.name: assignEntityString
functions.notes: Assigns a libc++ string to an entity slot, invalidating two global name caches and the per-cell cache, and stamps two id tables when the caches still differ.

functions.name: publishSpawnedHandle
functions.notes: Publishes a spawned handle: sets entity flag bit 2, clears per-cell caches, stamps three id tables, appends the handle to the world active-handle vector, writes entity+400/+404, then clears caches and rewrites two id tables.

validation.comparison: 33 string-assignment cases (SSO/heap/equal/different/empty/embedded NUL/primed caches) and 24 publish cases (capacity 0/exact/double/1024/4096, cache variants, repeats) compare void result, complete memory and stack pointer.
limitations: 265 global-cache initial contents were tested as zero or primed malloc buffers only.
266 illegal size>capacity states are not exercised.
Function 264 (spatial tree insertion) was attempted but its synthetic tests did not generalize to the real world; it is not registered.
Ledger: 250 server bodies recovered and 484 remain machine code.
